Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for agreeing to move forward with Redwood. To get your account into our vendor/payables system and issue a PO, procurement needs a completed W-9 (for US entities) or W-8BEN-E (if non-US), plus a confirmation of the EIN/tax ID. Could you send a completed copy of your W-9 and either an IRS EIN confirmation letter or a bank letter that references the EIN?

Also please confirm the legal entity name and the desired remit-to address exactly as it should appear on the PO. Our standard terms are Net 30 unless otherwise agreed.

Next steps from our side after we receive the docs: finance will verify the EIN, we’ll create a PO, and I’ll send a PO number and instruction for invoicing. If you want Net 15/Net 45, please flag that and we can route for approval.
